title: Understanding MSE on Training Data
text: Mean Squared Error (MSE) on training data measures how well the model fits the training data. Removing a feature can affect this fit.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, it can lead to a worse fit on the training data because the model has less information to work with.

title: Possible Outcomes
text: Consider how removing a feature might increase the error on the training data because the model might not capture all the patterns as effectively.
